_: THE connector catalogue, once: every card the Connections tab shows - the working ones (seeded as connector rows on first launch, store.py) and the planned ones - with a group, a one-line desc and `match`: the words in mail, chats, tasks and reports that mean this system. The tab reads it (connectorCatalog.js); the Assistant report reads it to suggest what to connect (assistant.connect_ideas). Add `match` words by hand when a system is known by another name.

cards.title: Outlook mail
cards.desc: Your Microsoft mailbox on the Timeline through triage. Sign in with your own account - no Azure portal - or register your own app if you prefer.

cards.title: Microsoft Teams
cards.desc: Ingest Teams chats via Graph. Leave credentials blank to reuse the Outlook connector's app.

cards.title: Slack
cards.desc: Ingest Slack channels with a bot token - messages land on the Timeline through triage.

cards.title: GitHub
cards.desc: Paste a PAT - repos are auto-discovered, feed the Board's repo picker and the coder's issue loop. Per repo, choose what issues and PRs do: tasks, feed, or off.

cards.title: Anthropic API
cards.desc: Claude via the Anthropic API - powers intent triage (task / reply-only / FYI) once enabled.

cards.title: OpenAI API
cards.desc: OpenAI models for intent triage - alternative to the Anthropic connector.

cards.title: Azure OpenAI
cards.desc: Your Azure OpenAI deployment for intent triage - endpoint + deployment + key.

cards.title: OpenRouter
cards.desc: One key, the whole catalog — open-weights Llama / Qwen / Mistral and every closed model, through OpenRouter's OpenAI-compatible API.

cards.title: Local models (Ollama)
cards.desc: Open-source models on YOUR machine — Ollama out of the box, or any OpenAI-compatible server (LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM). Your mail never leaves the box.

cards.title: Meta Model API (Muse Spark)
cards.desc: Meta's Muse Spark models through the Meta Model API — the way to reach Muse Spark on Windows, where the muse CLI does not install.

cards.title: TypeSafe Jev (decisions only)
cards.desc: TypeSafe's Jev — answers typed questions with calibrated probabilities instead of words. It can decide where a finished report goes; it cannot write one.

cards.title: Telegram
cards.desc: A Telegram bot as an inbound channel - approved chats flow through triage; approved replies go back into the same chat. Unknown chats never become work: a bot is public.

cards.title: WhatsApp
cards.desc: Your own WhatsApp, via a small bridge that runs beside Taskuary (Baileys, installed separately) - chats flow through triage, approved replies go back into the chat.

cards.title: Apple Messages
cards.desc: The Mac's own Messages — iMessage, SMS and RCS that reach this machine. Chats flow through triage, approved replies go back into the same chat through Messages.app. macOS only.

cards.title: Gmail / Google Workspace
cards.desc: A Gmail or Google Workspace mailbox - IMAP in through triage, replies back over Gmail's own SMTP, in-thread. Optional OAuth fields add the calendar.

cards.title: Any mailbox (IMAP)
cards.desc: Any mailbox that speaks IMAP - a domain.com address, Yahoo, an ISP, your webhost. In through triage, replies out over its SMTP.

cards.title: Jira
cards.desc: Jira issues ASSIGNED TO YOU land on the Timeline through triage — 'assigned in Jira' and 'asked by email' end up in the one funnel.

cards.title: Asana
cards.desc: Asana tasks ASSIGNED TO YOU land on the Timeline through triage, linking back to Asana.

cards.title: Monday.com
cards.desc: Monday.com items ASSIGNED TO YOU (any People column naming you) land on the Timeline through triage.

cards.title: ClickUp
cards.desc: ClickUp tasks ASSIGNED TO YOU land on the Timeline through triage, with their list, status and priority.

cards.title: Todoist
cards.desc: The Todoist tasks a filter says are live — due today and overdue by default — land on the Timeline through triage.

cards.title: GitLab
cards.desc: GitLab issues and merge requests ASSIGNED TO YOU land on the Timeline through triage — gitlab.com or your own instance.

cards.title: Azure DevOps
cards.desc: Azure DevOps work items ASSIGNED TO YOU land on the Timeline through triage.

cards.title: Linear
cards.desc: Linear issues ASSIGNED TO YOU land on the Timeline through triage.

cards.title: Trello
cards.desc: Open Trello cards ASSIGNED TO YOU land on the Timeline through triage.

cards.title: Notion
cards.desc: Notion pages shared with your integration show on the Timeline as they change — a FEED by default: edits are information, not assignments.

cards.title: Discord
cards.desc: Watch Discord channels with a bot — messages land on the Timeline through triage, and approved replies post back to the channel.

cards.title: Sentry
cards.desc: New unresolved Sentry errors land on the Timeline through triage — production breakage joins the same funnel as the mail about it.

cards.title: PagerDuty
cards.desc: Open PagerDuty incidents (triggered / acknowledged) land on the Timeline through triage.

cards.title: Google Gemini transcription
cards.desc: Google Gemini transcription — accurate speech-to-text with native custom-vocabulary biasing for names, acronyms and system terms.

cards.title: Groq (Whisper)
cards.desc: Whisper on Groq — the cheapest hosted transcription (free tier; ~$0.04 per audio hour after) and the fastest: an hour of audio in seconds.

cards.title: OpenAI transcription
cards.desc: OpenAI transcription — gpt-4o-mini-transcribe is cheap ($0.003/min) and accurate; gpt-4o-transcribe is the accuracy leader on independent benchmarks.

cards.title: Deepgram
cards.desc: Deepgram Nova-3 — the fastest hosted API, ~$0.26 per audio hour, very strong accuracy, generous free credit to start.

cards.title: ElevenLabs Scribe
cards.desc: ElevenLabs Scribe — top-tier accuracy across 99 languages, ~$0.22 per audio hour; the pick when notes arrive in several languages.

cards.title: Any Whisper server
cards.desc: Any speech-to-text server speaking the OpenAI audio endpoint: speaches (faster-whisper), whisper.cpp server, LocalAI — audio stays on your network.

cards.title: Local Whisper
cards.desc: Whisper on this machine, no key and no server — faster-whisper inside Taskuary. Audio never leaves the box; the first run downloads the model.

cards.title: OpenAI images
cards.desc: OpenAI image generation — gpt-image-1 renders text inside a picture legibly, which matters for diagrams and mock-ups.

cards.title: Azure OpenAI images
cards.desc: The same models through your own Azure tenant — the prompt stays inside your subscription and its data agreements.

cards.title: Google Gemini images
cards.desc: Google's image model — fast, cheap, and strong at editing an idea in words rather than restarting from scratch.

cards.title: Stability AI
cards.desc: Stable Image from Stability AI — credits rather than a subscription, and core is inexpensive per picture.

cards.title: OpenRouter images
cards.desc: One key, many image models — OpenRouter bills them all together, so you can switch model without a new account.

cards.title: Replicate
cards.desc: FLUX, SDXL, Ideogram, Recraft and hundreds more behind one token — change the model field and you have changed vendor, with no new card.

cards.title: xAI Grok images
cards.desc: xAI's image model, on the same OpenAI-shaped endpoint — useful if you already hold an xAI key.

cards.title: Any image server
cards.desc: Any server speaking the OpenAI images endpoint — ComfyUI or Automatic1111 behind a compatible proxy, LocalAI, vLLM. Nothing leaves the machine and nothing is billed.

cards.title: Google Gemini API
cards.desc: Gemini models through Google AI Studio

cards.title: Groq inference
cards.desc: Fast hosted inference for open models

cards.title: AWS Bedrock
cards.desc: Claude, Llama and other models through AWS

cards.title: Google Vertex AI
cards.desc: Gemini and partner models through GCP

cards.title: Matrix
cards.desc: Open Matrix rooms and direct messages

cards.title: Signal
cards.desc: Signal conversations through a local bridge

cards.title: PostgreSQL
cards.desc: Postgres databases without a hand-written URL

cards.title: NetSuite
cards.desc: ERP records, saved searches and reports

cards.title: BambooHR
cards.desc: People, time off and employee data

cards.title: Plaid
cards.desc: Bank account and transaction data through a linked-account aggregator

cards.title: EOD Historical Data
cards.desc: End-of-day and fundamental data across global exchanges

cards.title: Marketstack
cards.desc: Historical and intraday stock market data

cards.title: Intrinio
cards.desc: Financial data feeds and fundamentals for public companies

cards.title: Benzinga
cards.desc: Market news, analyst ratings and calendar events

cards.title: Apify
cards.desc: Hosted crawlers and structured web datasets

cards.title: DeepSeek
cards.desc: Open reasoning models at roughly a tenth of the usual price - the cheapest capable triage brain here.
